title: Fix tunnel-auth COSE example algorithm encoding off by one
description: spec/06-security.md section 8.11 normatively assigns Schnorr48-Ed25519 algorithm -65537, but the example protected-header bytes a10139ffff decode to -65536. The mathematically correct deterministic CBOR for {1: -65537} is a1013a00010000. Reconcile the example/comment and directly coupled tunnel-auth vectors without changing the assigned algorithm; add a doc/vector consistency assertion so implementations do not diverge.
notes: Corrected only the tunnel-authorization COSE_Sign1 protected-header example in spec/06-security.md section 8.11 from a10139ffff (-65536) to canonical a1013a00010000 ({1:-65537}); preserved all unrelated accumulated spec edits. Directly coupled Python/Rust tunnel implementations already use the correct bytes, and python/tests/gateway/test_tunnel_auth.py contains a fixed byte-for-byte independent assertion. Validation: scoped section search confirms exactly one correct encoding and no stale encoding in 8.11; cbor2 decodes the bytes as {1:-65537} and canonical re-encoding is identical; focused canonical vector test passed; git diff --check passed.
close_reason: Tunnel-auth example now encodes normative COSE algorithm -65537 and scoped consistency checks pass
